title: Your Social Reflection
signalsFormingDesc: Your profile is live. Share the link for friends to read you. Outside Seenly and The Gap unlock at 3 responses.
lockedSectionOutsideDesc: Requires 3 friend responses to unlock your Outside Seenly analysis.
lockedSectionGapDesc: Requires 3 friend responses to reveal the alignment gap (The Gap) between self and outer perceptions.

gap.title: The Alignment Gap (The Gap)
gap.blindSpotDesc: Your circle perceives your {category} significantly higher than you rate yourself. This trait projects outward stronger than you realize.
gap.illusionDesc: While you feel {category} strongly internally, you project it more subtly to others. This potential may not be fully visible to your circle.
gap.socialMaskDesc: While you feel {category} strongly internally, you project it more subtly to others. This potential may not be fully visible to your circle.
gap.alignmentDesc: {category} is where your self-perception and outside observations are closest to each other. You project a balanced, authentic, and natural presence in this dimension.
gap.insightDesc: This gap represents the unique intersection between your inner self-perception and the social signals you radiate to the outside world. Rather than a misalignment, it highlights the hidden, authentic impact you leave on others.
gap.alignLevelHigh: at its peak and highly intense
gap.contrastBlindSpotHigh: reflects outwards far beyond your expectations
gap.contrastBlindSpotLow: stands out with a more noticeable presence compared to your self-view
gap.contrastIllusionHigh: projecting a much calmer presence externally compared to your rich inner world
gap.contrastIllusionLow: projecting it in a slightly more balanced and subtle manner to the outside world
gap.overviewDesc: The alignment between how you see yourself and how others see you.
gap.insightGuideDesc: This gap represents the unique intersection between your inner self-perception and the social signals you radiate to the outside world. Rather than a misalignment, it highlights the hidden, authentic impact you leave on others.

decisionTimes.lockedDesc: Discover which questions your friends hesitated on the most, profile visits, and cognitive decision times with Seenly Plus.
decisionTimes.profileVisitsDesc: Analyzes the response rate and the initial impression left on people who visited your link.
decisionTimes.hesitatingDesc: When people completed this analysis about you, they spent the longest time pondering questions focused on {signal}. This indicates that this trait does not reflect as a simple, uniform line to the outside world. This aspect of your personality sparks deep curiosity, making it the domain they contemplated most before deciding.
decisionTimes.confidentDesc: Your friends navigated through questions regarding {signal} within milliseconds without a single hesitation. Your projection in this area is so clear and indisputable to the outside world that your circle validated this power instantly, requiring no secondary thought.
decisionTimes.noVisitsYet: Your profile has not received visits yet. Visitor breakdown will be analyzed once shared.
decisionTimes.visitsBreakdown: {total} people opened your profile. {silent} silently browsed without answering, and {responders} completed the quiz.
decisionTimes.hesitationCardDesc: The trait where your circle paused the longest before answering.
decisionTimes.convictionCardDesc: The question your friends spent the least time reflecting on. Your most clearly recognized trait.

responses.tabDesc: Chronological feed of anonymous individual analyses left by your friends.
responses.empty: No responses yet. Share your profile link to get your first signals.
responses.lockDesc: Upgrade to Plus to view this response detail, signal scores, and timing analysis.
responses.lockWarning: Privacy Guard: Even if you unlock this analysis, the identity of the voter remains hidden. All reflections are completely anonymous.
responses.privacyGuardTeaser: Privacy Guard: All reflections remain 100% anonymous.
responses.signalsDistributionDesc: Signals read by this respondent across questions:
responses.cognitiveRhythmDesc: Where did they spend the most and least time?
responses.anonymousReviewsDesc: Review all individual friend answers and question-by-question breakdowns completely anonymously.
responses.noAnalysesYetDesc: Copy your profile link from above and send it to your friends to start gathering your first reflections!
